blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) is tightening capital and prudential requirements for thrift, rural and cooperative banks that are shifting toward digital banking models, seeking to ensure that faster-growing lenders maintain adequate safeguards.
